passes: Exact canonical home visual is preserved in QA canon mode.
Sanctuary -> Library transition is wired and renders.
Visual language, palette and source art remain coherent.

blockers.title: No true layered 2.5D scene
blockers.detail: The live scene animates the entire canonical PNG as one plane. Foreground architecture, traveler, citadel, clouds and UI are not independently depth-separated.

blockers.title: VOIR and AGIR are not real destinations
blockers.detail: Their hotspots trigger only a flash. Only COMPRENDRE changes scene.

blockers.title: Transition is still a flat scene swap
blockers.detail: Sanctuary -> Library uses flash/crossfade rather than a camera/portal traversal with depth continuity.

blockers.title: Debug overlays are visible
blockers.detail: The 'Golden Sanctuary v1...' hint and 'Retour au Sanctuaire' floating button break the canonical presentation.

blockers.title: Atmosphere is generic rather than scene-aware
blockers.detail: Glow and fog are CSS overlays. Flames, particles, portal, clouds and traveler/cape are not independently animated.

blockers.title: Library is not interactive yet
blockers.detail: The library renders as a flat canonical image; search, content cards and navigation are not functional.

next_iteration_acceptance_criteria: At least 5 independent depth layers in the Sanctuary with visibly different parallax.
Traveler isolated as a distinct layer with clean edges and no revealed holes during motion.
Foreground architecture separated from distant world.
No debug overlay in production mode.
COMPRENDRE transition uses camera push/portal traversal rather than only flash/fade.
VOIR and AGIR either have real destinations or are explicitly locked/non-interactive.
Browser evidence captures center/rest and motion states.
Independent review rerun on observed browser captures before Human Gate.
recommended_next_action: Reopen implementation as LUMEN-SCENE-ENGINE-01R and rebuild the Sanctuary as a true layered 2.5D scene before adding more screens.
